description: Knowledge matrix tracking what each character knows at each milestone across Book 1 (38 chapters). Derived from kernel, mystery ledger, threads, and author directive. Milestones are computed as 5 slots from 38 chapters: ch1 (2%), ch8 (20%), ch19 (50%), ch27 (72%), ch38 (100%). Character keys use exact milestone chapter numbers.

known_facts: She is a vigilante executioner who kills guilty men the system failed to punish.
Her public identity is a famous true-crime podcaster.
Her origin wound: her sister Mara Reyes was murdered by a man who walked free.
Her first kill was the man who murdered Mara — a staged car accident.
She has a hidden network: Sasha Okafor (lawyer), Priya Anand (coroner), Wren Delgado (hacker).
Her new target is Damien Kroll, guilty of a cold-case murder.
ch1.hidden_truth: Damien Kroll will figure out what she is by chapter 8.

known_facts: All facts from ch1.
Damien Kroll has figured out that she is a vigilante executioner.
Kroll has begun a counter-investigation into her past, including her sister's case.
Her network is still loyal (no betrayal yet).
She is now aware of the two-way hunt.
must_not_know_before: Priya Anand is the leak (known only at ch28).
Kroll's dead-man's-switch evidence (known at ch20).
ch8.hidden_truth: Priya Anand is being coerced by Kroll (unknown to Elle until ch28).

known_facts: All facts from ch8.
Kroll has evidence of her first kill and a dead-man's-switch (revealed at ch20, but Elle suspects by ch19).
The network is starting to fracture; tension with Priya is noticeable.
Elle has revealed to Wren that her first kill was a car accident (in a moment of vulnerability).
Midpoint: hunter becomes hunted — Elle realizes Kroll has the upper hand.
must_not_know_before: Priya is the leak (known at ch28).
The full details of Kroll's dead-man's-switch (known at ch20).
ch19.hidden_truth: Kroll's dead-man's-switch is real and contains the evidence.

known_facts: All facts from ch19.
Kroll's dead-man's-switch is confirmed (from ch20).
Elle suspects someone in her network is leaking (but not sure who).
She has located the safe-deposit box key (ch24).
She is closing in on Kroll, but he is also closing in on her.
must_not_know_before: Priya is the leak (known at ch28).
The full contents of the safe-deposit box (known at ch36).
ch27.hidden_truth: Priya's betrayal will be revealed in ch28.

known_facts: All facts from ch27.
Priya Anand is the leak (revealed at ch28, motive: Kroll threatened her family).
Elle's origin wound fully revealed (ch34): Mara's killer was Lucas Vance; Elle killed him in a staged accident.
Elle engineered Kroll's death as a staged suicide (ch36), with a fake confession aired on her podcast.
Kroll's dead-man's-switch evidence of her first kill has been triggered (ch37).
An encrypted email from an unknown third party arrives (ch38): 'You work for us now, Elle. Reply to confirm.'
Detective Marcus Holt suspects Kroll's death is not a suicide (ch38).
ch38.hidden_truth: The unknown third party holds the evidence and will be the antagonist of Book 2.
